title: Play-Nice Contract Attestation and Commitment
description: Proof that the exact applicable contracts were read and understood before mutating work (receipt + version/hash + task-impact), and the operational commitment that they will actively govern the work. Neither is ever authorization.

revision.description: Library revision the bundle was resolved from.

receipt.description: Bundle receipt derived from the selected versions and hashes, e.g. cedar-lantern-47.

conflict.description: Required when status is CONFLICT: the specific conflicting rule pair and the safest reversible interpretation.

task_impact.description: For each applicable contract, one concrete sentence stating how it changes what this task will do. Forces application, not mere retrieval.

conflicts.description: Null or 'none' when no material conflicts. Otherwise the full conflict explanation.

gate.description: PASS permits commitment (and then mutating work) to proceed. BLOCKED means a material contract conflict or failed verification must be resolved first.

commitment.description: CONTRACT OPERATIONAL COMMITMENT v1. Required before mutating work. Not legal acceptance — an operating state.

role.description: Participant role in the propagation tree.

bundle_sha256.description: Exact resolved bundle material hash. Stale bundles invalidate the commitment.

inherited_bundle.description: Workers only: the parent orchestrator's bundle hash. A worker may resolve additional contracts but may not drop the parent's applicable constraints.

receipt.description: Three-word hyphenated phrase from the hidden receipt comment in the contract file.
